topbar.welcome: Welcome to KidSmile — Making Little Smiles Bright, Happy & Cavity-Free!

hero.subtitle: Safe, gentle, and fear-free pediatric dental care where every visit feels like a fun adventure. We turn dental visits into magical smile moments!

about.title: Gentle, Fun & Caring — Just What Your Child Needs
about.description: We specialize exclusively in children's dentistry. From infant teething checkups to teenager smile alignments, our warm team creates a comforting, playful environment designed to eliminate dental anxiety forever.

services.title: Specialized Care for Every Childhood Stage
services.subtitle: From baby teeth to bright teenage smiles, we deliver gentle, anxiety-free pediatric dentistry with love and modern technology.
services.service1Desc: A cozy, playful lap-to-lap exam to celebrate first teeth, prevent early baby bottle decay, and guide parents on gentle teething relief.
services.service2Desc: Bubblegum flavored gentle cleanings, painless cavity-preventing fluoride paint, and playful brushing education that kids love.
services.service3Desc: Whisper-quiet, invisible BPA-free protective coatings and gentle micro-fillings that lock out sugar bugs permanently.
services.service4Desc: Early bite development checks, fun rainbow-colored braces, and comfortable clear aligners for confident growing smiles.

whyus.title: Nurturing Little Smiles with Love, Care & Magic
whyus.subtitle: We transformed the dental visit into a magical playground where kids feel relaxed, empowered, and eager to brush.
whyus.item1Desc: Kids pick their favorite movie or cartoon with wireless headphones while our gentle dentist takes care of their teeth.
whyus.item2Desc: State-of-the-art needle-free, gentle water laser treatment so children never feel anxious or uncomfortable.
whyus.item3Desc: Every brave little patient collects gold tokens after their visit to unlock toy machines and golden tooth certificates.

results.title: Thousands of Bright Smiles Built Together

testimonials.title: What Loving Parents Say About Us
testimonials.subtitle: Real stories from families who replaced dental fear with laughter and glowing teeth.
testimonials.quote1: KidSmile has been a miraculous experience for my 5-year-old daughter. She used to cry at doctor visits, but here she asks when we can visit Dr. Lily again!
testimonials.quote2: The video games in the lobby and Netflix on the ceiling made my twins forget they were even at a dental clinic. Truly compassionate staff!
testimonials.quote3: They caught my son's crossbite early and gently corrected it with rainbow braces. He smiles in every school photo with pride now!

tour.title: Take a 3D Dental Adventure Tour
tour.subtitle: Explore our sensory-friendly rooms, jungle waiting lounge, and sterilization labs before your first visit.

team.title: Meet Our Caring Pediatric Specialists
team.subtitle: Board-certified pediatric dentists, gentle dental hygienists, and friendly smile cheerleaders.
team.member1Bio: Passionate about gentle infant dental care and sensory-friendly treatments with 14 years of pediatric practice.
team.member2Bio: Specialist in early jaw growth, colorful braces, and playful confidence-building for teenagers.
team.member3Bio: Expert in turning dental cleanings into fun bubble-blowing games that kids love.
